title: OpenWRT — Network
description: WAN throughput, WiFi AP traffic, Tailscale VPN, LAN interfaces, and interface status.

panels.title: WAN Download (RX)
panels.description: Bytes per second received on the WAN interface (internet download)

panels.title: WAN Upload (TX)
panels.description: Bytes per second transmitted on the WAN interface (internet upload)

panels.title: WAN Packets/sec
panels.description: Packets per second on WAN. High PPS with low bytes = many small packets (DNS, keepalives).

panels.title: WAN Errors & Drops
panels.description: Non-zero errors indicate hardware problems, driver issues, or line quality issues.

panels.title: Gateway Packet Loss
panels.description: Packet loss percentage to the IPv4 default gateway. This separates LAN-side gateway reachability from internet probe loss.

panels.title: Public IP Changed
panels.description: 1 when the public IP changed on the latest throttled lookup, otherwise 0.

panels.title: DNS Probe
panels.description: DNS resolution probe for the configured host. 1 = successful, 0 = failed.

panels.title: DNS Probe Duration
panels.description: DNS probe duration from the router textfile collector. The BusyBox implementation reports whole seconds.

panels.title: Named nftables Counter Rate
panels.description: Packet rate from explicitly named nftables counters. Add only bounded counters such as WAN reject/drop rules.

panels.title: mwan3 Interface Status
panels.description: Optional mwan3 collector metrics. This table is empty when mwan3 is not installed.

panels.title: mwan3 Interfaces Up
panels.description: Interface up status from the optional mwan3 collector.

panels.title: mwan3 Interface Score
panels.description: mwan3 interface score over time. Empty when mwan3 is absent.

panels.title: SQM Backlog
panels.description: Optional disabled-by-default SQM/cake textfile collector backlog. Empty until ENABLE_SQM_METRICS=1 is configured.

panels.title: SQM Drops
panels.description: SQM/cake dropped packet rate for configured egress and IFB ingress interfaces.

panels.title: SQM Overlimits
panels.description: SQM/cake overlimit rate for configured interfaces.

panels.title: WiFi AP Throughput — Both Bands
panels.description: Traffic on the configured 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz WiFi access point interfaces

panels.title: WiFi AP Signal & Noise
panels.description: AP-level signal and noise from the optional wifi collector. Empty when the collector is unavailable.

panels.title: WiFi AP Quality
panels.description: AP-level quality percentage from the optional wifi collector.

panels.title: WiFi AP Bitrate
panels.description: AP-level bitrate from the optional wifi collector. The collector reports kilobits/sec, so the query converts to bits/sec.

panels.title: All Interface Throughput (RX)
panels.description: RX throughput per interface. Excludes loopback and unused LAN ports (lan2, lan3).

panels.title: All Interface Throughput (TX)
panels.description: TX throughput per interface. Excludes loopback and unused LAN ports.

panels.title: IPv6 Packets
panels.description: Curated IPv6 packet counters from the optional snmp6 collector. Empty when snmp6 is unavailable.

panels.title: IPv6 Discards
panels.description: Optional IPv6 discard counters. Non-zero sustained rates can indicate path or forwarding issues.

panels.title: IPv6 Octets
panels.description: Curated IPv6 byte counters from the optional snmp6 collector.

panels.title: Tailscale VPN Throughput
panels.description: Traffic flowing through the Tailscale VPN tunnel

panels.title: NAT Conntrack Sessions
panels.description: NAT connection tracking table usage vs limit. Approaching the limit causes new connections to fail.

panels.title: Network Interface Status
panels.description: Current state of all network interfaces
